name: the Ohienko Ukrainian Bible
title: Ohienko (UBIO) against BHSA and Nestle 1904
notes: «на початку» = בְּ + רֵאשִׁית: a Ukrainian preposition with its noun may render one Hebrew word with its prefix.
Ukrainian «і», «та», «а» link to וְ/καί when they render it.
A Ukrainian possessive or pronoun («його», «Свій») links to the original word that carries that suffix or pronoun.
Ohienko's New Testament follows the Received Text, so a Ukrainian word with no Nestle 1904 counterpart is not an error: leave it unlinked.

The corpus numbers Ohienko's verses as the English Bibles do: a psalm title is part of verse 1 here while the Hebrew numbers it as a verse of its own, and chapter ends differ in places; the frame line shows which Hebrew verses each verse maps to, and a link into the next Hebrew verse there is not a link to the wrong verse.
